d: Imagine a village of just 350 people facing the prospect of 1,256 male asylum seekers being housed nearby. That's the reality confronting Piddington in Oxfordshire. The government's plans to convert a former military site into asylum accommodation have sparked fierce opposition. Residents have raised safety concerns, taken self-defence classes and even held a symbolic referendum to declare independence from the UK. The row reflects a much bigger immigration crisis gripping Britain, as the government struggles to end costly hotel accommodation while communities push back against new migrant…
